visual.source: Creo export propeller.stl with the CREO settings transform

warnings: Ct(J) and Cp(J) are the Proptimiser model scaled to the static test. The J > 0 part is not measured.
The rpm is a model estimate from the torque (kappa 1.066, R_tot 0.156 ohm from the vendor datasheet; V_bus 44.4 V +/- 3.5 V from the cell limits).
Type B inputs at their default: air_density (ISA value, not measured), load_cell_rel, torque_sensor_rel.
No idle rows. The tare comes from the rows at the lowest throttle (20 %).
Air density is the ISA sea-level value. Add the test block to run.yaml to use the measured value.
The stand throttle (%) is taken as the normalized ESC command (linear in PWM between pwm_low and pwm_high).
The rows of this run were typed by hand. Thrust and torque have coarse steps.
M1 (model table against the rows (command 30 % and above)): The RMS gap 0.077 (max 0.161) exceeds the combined band 0.009. Gaps are in power fraction.
C1 (thrust and torque calibration): No calibration date in run.yaml. The intervals hold only the default sensor gain errors.
D3 skip: The rpm channel of this run is missing. The rpm is a model estimate.
D4 skip: The rpm channel of this run is missing. The rpm is a model estimate.
P4 inconclusive: Figure of merit, peak eta, tip Mach (95 % intervals)
P8 skip: No valid electrical data (current must exceed 1 A and voltage must reach 23.0 V). Efficiency and the battery link are not available.
R2 inconclusive: Ct0 goes with 1/n^2 and Cp0 with 1/n^3, so the intervals of Ct0 and Cp0 are wide.
